name: Hindsight
tagline: Lessons from your own projects and from the industry’s, cited to the page and surfaced at the stage where they apply.
problem: Lessons are written at close-out and filed, then the same mistakes recur on the next project.
how: Close-out reports, change logs, claims, audits, inquiries and published reviews
Extracts lessons, links each to its source page, and tests which practices predicted outcomes
Lessons pushed to the next project at the matching stage and gate, and closed only when practice changes
features: Internal lessons: From the owner’s own close-out reports, change logs and claims
External lessons: From public audits, inquiries, regulator reports and published reviews
Cited search: Any project document searched and questioned, each answer linked to its page
Lessons diagnostic: Which practices predicted outcomes in the owner’s record
Lessons that bind: A lesson closes only when an artefact has changed
At the right moment: Lessons surfaced at the matching stage and gate of the next project
Lesson brief: A brief of the lessons that apply, generated for each stage and gate
